paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: This line plot, titled "Prompt Length vs Accuracy," illustrates how the accuracy of two models, labeled "mmsd" and "mmsd2," changes as the prompt length increases from 2 to 16. The x-axis, labeled "Prompt Length," uses a linear scale with integer tick marks at even intervals from 2 to 16. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," uses a linear scale ranging from 77 to 81. The "mmsd" model is represented by a solid red line with circular markers, starting at an accuracy of 81.0 at prompt length 2, dropping to 80.5 at length 4, rising to a peak of 80.9 at length 8, and then stabilizing near 80.8 for the remainder of the range. The "mmsd2" model is represented by a solid yellow line with circular markers, beginning at 77.3 at prompt length 2, decreasing to a low of 76.8 at length 4, rising to 77.2 at length 8, and then gradually declining to 76.7 at length 16.
